candidates.title: VRAM prediction over-counts KV cache 4-8x for hybrid models (recurrent/SSM blocks, OLLAMA_KV_CACHE_TYPE ignored), evicting runners loaded with keep_alive=-1
candidates.snippet: ### What is the issue?  `PredictServerVRAM` (`llm/llama_server.go`) over-predicts the KV cache by **4–8x** for hybrid architectures (recurrent/SSM blocks, e.g. Qwen3.5/3.8, Qwen3-Next-style models), and always bills it as f16 regardless of `OLLAMA_KV_CACHE_TYPE`. Combined with the `predicted > 80% * available` pre-flight in `server/sched.go`, this evicts perfectly healthy runners — including ones loaded with `keep_alive: -1` — and the scheduler never brings them back.
